mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_reservation (student_id, device_id, reservation_date, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{deviceId}, #{reservationDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
